sensor: Elastreme Sense Slim M; four middle-arm paths with the multichannel box

manufacturer.fatigue: ΔR/R < 1% after 10,000 cycles at 50% strain, as reported by manufacturer; distinct from intra-cycle hysteresis
manufacturer.repeatability_figure: Compare plateau direction and sag against page 2 of the supplied datasheet. It does not contain a synchronous imposed length trace, numeric resistance scale, or separate unloading curve.

readout: Historical measured frame intervals around 24.9 ms, 3 identified channels. Fourth simulated channel has its own deformation and uses median readout and memory parameters.
scope: Replay on previously registered simulation motions. Step and loop tests isolate the electrical model; no additional mechanical force applied to the plant. Adhesive slip, preload relaxation over hours, temperature coefficients, self-heating, cable motion and rate-dependent bonding are not individually identified.
static_model: Digitized 25 °C curve, tensile limit, independent observed timing, raw stationary noise, quantization and measured effective gain
memory_model: Rate-independent play on normalized resistance, plus a slow decaying term with immediate feedthrough. Simulated material states are evaluated at the plant rate; output is sampled on the actual box clock. Decay uses exact linear-input integration; only past states affect current output.
sensitivity: h=0.02, weight=0.5 means a major-branch gap of 0.02 in ΔR/R0. Slow transient weight 0.02 and tau=2 s are exploratory knobs; neither a reported sensor constant nor calibrated from six plateau pixels.
transfer: 20260619_161413 used for effective preprocessing and memory fitting. Selection grid by chronological 68/32 fit check. Parameters refit on entire fitting recording and frozen before prediction on 20260619_163049. Sparse comparison is conditional on optical bending vector; no measured local length. All 3 slow weights hit search limits, so time constants cannot be claimed as material parameters.
units: Raw box counts and angular RMSE have different physical units and are reported separately.
literature_method: Di Tocco et al., Sensors 22 (2022) 3954, DOI 10.3390/s22103954. Fig. 5 cyclic hysteresis, Fig. 7 rate, Fig. 8 hold drift. The study uses a different sensor material; no numeric parameters copied.
